NEET Exam Controversy Sparks Protests and Political Debate Across India

Widespread protests erupted across India concerning the NEET-UG medical entrance exam, with allegations of irregularities and a paper leak. Hundreds were detained during demonstrations in multiple states. Opposition leaders questioned the government's handling of the issue, demanding parliamentary discussion. In Karnataka, the Deputy Chief Minister urged the Prime Minister to roll back NEET and reinstate state-level Common Entrance Tests. Meanwhile, Assam's Chief Minister asked the public not to troll his ministerial colleague whose daughter participated in a protest.
